title: Sum bound from powers of two
statement:
Let $a$, $b$, $c_a$, $c_b$ be natural numbers with $a \le 2^{c_a}$ and $b \le 2^{c_b}$. Then
\[
a + b \le 2^{1 + \max(c_a, c_b)}.
\]
hypotheses_covered: a, b, c_a, c_b are natural numbers
replaced:
For natural numbers $a, b, c_a, c_b$ with $a \le 2^{c_a}$ and $b \le 2^{c_b}$, one has
$a + b \le 2^{1 + \max(c_a, c_b)}$.
